evidence.title: Kasi Cloud Datacenters Commissions West Africa's First Hyperscale-Ready, AI-Capable Data Centre Campus in Lagos
evidence.excerpt: Kasi says LOS1 moved from construction into commissioning and operational-readiness work, while full commercial operation still depends on phased integration and customer-readiness activities.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 67143-byte content-decoded public GlobeNewswire HTML response body captured with curl --compressed
metadata.capture_headers_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 2353-byte raw HTTP response-header capture
metadata.capture_curl_writeout_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 13257-byte full curl %{json} effective-response facts capture
metadata.capture_artifact_guardrail: The exact response body, raw headers, and full curl facts remain temporary verification artifacts and are not redistributed. The full curl facts include endpoint, certificate, and local-network telemetry; this derived record retains only artifact hashes and narrow non-sensitive response facts.
metadata.request_metadata_guardrail: No request credential, certificate, cookie, local address, remote address, port value, or TLS verification result is copied into this derived record.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at uses the response HTTP Date at whole-second UTC precision. It is a retrieval timestamp, not publication time or a lifecycle date.
metadata.canonical_url_basis: The zero-redirect requested and effective URLs are byte-identical and match the HTML canonical URL.
metadata.lifecycle_scope: The company explicitly says LOS1 is transitioning from construction into commissioning and operational readiness and that phased commissioning, systems integration, and customer-readiness work will follow. This supports one commissioning lifecycle observation for LOS1 on May 19, 2026. It does not establish completion, occupancy, full commercial operation, operational capacity, current load, utilization, or measured energy consumption.
metadata.ceremony_guardrail: The flag-off ceremony and repeated commissioning label are interpreted together with the company's explicit description of remaining phased commissioning and integration work. The ceremony is not treated as proof that LOS1 or the wider campus is fully operational.
metadata.campus_project_scope: The approximately 100 MW figure covers the Lekki campus at full development, while LOS1 is only the first building and receives no source-supported MW value. The campus and LOS1 are represented once each; future LOS-coded buildings, individual data halls, and unique physical-site counts are not inferred.
metadata.capacity_scope: The approximately 100 MW value is explicitly long-term campus critical IT capacity and is normalized only as a planned campus row. It is not assigned to LOS1, treated as installed or energized, or converted into gross facility demand, grid connection, generation, current load, measured consumption, or annual energy.
metadata.pue_guardrail: The less-than-or-equal-to 1.6 PUE statement is an open-bound future target. It remains metadata and is not converted into a point estimate, measured PUE, or operational-efficiency observation.
metadata.power_guardrail: The 132 kV connection voltage is not power capacity and creates no MW row. The gas, solar, and battery descriptions have no source-supported nameplate sizes and create no generation or storage-capacity rows. N+1 is a design-redundancy label, not energy consumption.
metadata.workload_scope: LOS1 is expressly engineered for high-density AI and accelerated-computing environments and enterprise cloud platforms. This supports only broad intended ai_specialized_unspecified and general_cloud classifications. It does not establish installed accelerators, an AI training-versus-inference split, HPC as a distinct workload, named models, current customers, current compute activity, or workload shares.
metadata.operating_model_guardrail: Carrier-neutral describes the planned platform and connectivity posture, but the disclosure does not safely distinguish retail colocation, wholesale colocation, hyperscale lease, managed cloud, or another schema-supported operating model. No normalized operating-model observation is created.
metadata.role_scope: Kasi says it develops and operates hyperscale and AI-ready data-centre campuses, supporting developer and operator roles for the Lekki campus and LOS1. NSIA is described as a foundational investor but is retained only in evidence metadata because the release does not define its asset-level ownership or project scope. No owner, landlord, tenant, customer, user, utility, or contractor role is inferred.
metadata.location_scope: The company locates the campus in the Maiyegun area of Lekki, Lagos. This is retained as an authoritative locality only; no street address, parcel, boundary, point, footprint, geometry, or analyst geocode is created.
metadata.site_resolution_guardrail: The named campus and first-building code support one logical campus and one project but do not prove parcel topology, future building count, data-hall count, or a uniquely geolocated physical site. unique_site_counted remains false unless independently resolved.
metadata.tier_guardrail: Alignment with Uptime Institute Tier III standards is a company-reported design statement, not proof of an awarded certification, completed commissioning, or operating performance.
metadata.energy_guardrail: The disclosure supplies no operational electrical load, annual energy consumption, measured consumption, generation nameplate, renewable share, water use, cooling performance, or emissions observation. MW critical IT is not converted into MWh or annual energy.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher renderings, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, analyst geolocation, and image-based inference contribute nothing to identity, lifecycle, capacity, classification, roles, coordinates, geometry, or site resolution in this record.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from a public all-rights-reserved company-distributed press release; captured response bytes, response headers, curl telemetry, and publisher media are not redistributed.

capacities.notes: Approximate long-term critical-IT capacity for the full Lekki campus at complete development. It is not LOS1 capacity, installed or energized capacity, grid draw, gross-facility demand, generation, current load, measured consumption, or annual energy.
